title: User List
content: Create user list component for team management. List item: avatar (w-10 h-10 rounded-full), name (font-medium), email or role, status badge, actions. Status badges: Active (green), Invited (yellow), Inactive (gray). Actions: dropdown menu with Edit, Deactivate, Remove. List header: search input, role filter, Add User button. Sorting: by name, date, status. Pagination for long lists. Empty state: "No users found".

variants.simple: Create user list with avatars, names, roles, and status badges.
variants.detailed: Create user list component for team management. List item: avatar (w-10 h-10 rounded-full), name (font-medium), email or role, status badge, actions. Status badges: Active (green), Invited (yellow), Inactive (gray). Actions: dropdown menu with Edit, Deactivate, Remove. List header: search input, role filter, Add User button. Sorting: by name, date, status. Pagination for long lists. Empty state: "No users found".
variants.advanced: Create user list component for team or customer management with full features. List layout: table-style rows or card grid variant. List item row: flex items-center gap-4 py-4 border-b hover:bg-gray-50 transition. Content: avatar (w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover, fallback to initials in colored circle), name column (name as font-medium text-gray-900, email below as text-sm text-gray-500, or role), status badge, date added, actions. Status badges: Active (bg-green-100 text-green-800), Invited/Pending (bg-amber-100 text-amber-800), Inactive (bg-gray-100 text-gray-600), Admin (bg-purple-100 text-purple-800). Badge styling: px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium rounded-full. Actions: dropdown menu (MoreHorizontal trigger) with Edit Profile, Change Role, Resend Invite (if pending), Deactivate/Activate, Remove from team options, or inline icon buttons (Edit, Trash2). List header: flex justify-between items-center mb-4. Header left: search input (w-64, Search icon), role filter dropdown (All Roles, Admin, Member, Viewer). Header right: "Add User" or "Invite User" primary button. Sorting: click column headers to sort by name (A-Z, Z-A), date added (newest, oldest), status, role, last active. Sort indicator: ChevronUp/Down icon in header. Bulk selection: checkbox as first column, select all checkbox in header with indeterminate state, bulk actions toolbar (Change role, Remove selected) appears when rows selected. Pagination: for lists >20 users, page numbers or "Load more". Card variant: grid of user cards (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) with avatar centered, more profile details visible. Online status: green dot indicator (w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-green-500 absolute) positioned on avatar corner for currently online users. Last active: "Active 2h ago" or "Last seen Jan 15" timestamp. Quick profile: hover card (absolute positioned) showing more user details without navigation. Empty state: illustration with "No users found" message, "Invite your first team member" CTA. Loading: skeleton rows with avatar circle and text lines. Search: filter list as user types (debounced). Dark mode support. Accessibility: table semantics, sortable column announcements, checkbox labels.
